A section of cervical spinal cord at C6 was removed and processed into slides. Which of the following gross anatomic features is most likely true of this spinal cord level?

Options:
opa. Prominent lateral horns
opb. Least amount of white matter
opc. Absence of gray matter enlargement
opd. Involvement with parasympathetic nervous system
